Name: Deepwater Provisions
Description: Deepwater Provisions is a food company best known for its lutefisk, prepared at its own cannery and sold through outlets on several worlds. A corporation rather than a state, it hires mercenaries to protect its facilities and its executives.
ReputationStatements: Commander, Deepwater Provisions has a delicate matter that needs a professional touch.
Your company's reputation has reached our boardroom, Commander. We have work for you.
Commander, Deepwater Provisions remembers its friends. We need your help once again.
MissionSuccessStatements: Well done, Commander. Deepwater Provisions will not forget this.
GoodFaithFailureStatements: Not the result we paid for, Commander, but we see that you tried.
BadFaithFailureStatements: Deepwater Provisions expected professionals, Commander. We will remember this.
